routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of countries on Armenia's visa-free lists (unilateral or by treaty) can enter without a visa. They can stay up to 180 days in one year unless a treaty says otherwise. Check the official lists for your passport.

other: Passport must be on one of the two official visa-free lists (unilateral exemption, or bilateral/multilateral agreements). The country lists open as separate pages, so check yours before you go.
Holders of a UN or EU Laissez-Passer are also exempt, for up to 180 days in a year.

stay.note: Treaties can set a different length.

sources.label: MFA Armenia: Visa requirements for foreigners

routes.name: Temporary visa exemption for residents of US, EU, Schengen and Gulf states
routes.summary: Until July 1, 2027, citizens of 111 listed countries who hold a valid residence permit from the US, an EU or Schengen state, UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait or Oman can enter without a visa for up to 180 days in a year.

other: Passport must be from one of the 111 listed countries.
Residence permit must be valid at least 6 months from entry date.
Permit must be a physical card or passport sticker, with Latin-script details and Gregorian dates.

sources.label: MFA Armenia: list of 111 countries, temporary visa exemption (June 30, 2026)
MFA Armenia: Visa requirements for foreigners

routes.name: Visitor visa (eVisa)
routes.summary: If your passport isn't visa-exempt, apply online at the official eVisa portal. Two options: a visitor visa up to 21 days or up to 120 days. Processing is up to 3 working days.

other: Some nationalities can only get a visitor visa with an invitation, at an Armenian embassy or consulate. See the MFA invitation-only list.

stay.note: Visitor visas run up to 120 days. Extension for up to 60 more days goes through the Migration and Citizenship Service, unless a treaty says otherwise.

steps: Apply at evisa.mfa.am and pay the non-refundable fee.
To extend, apply to the Migration and Citizenship Service with the reason for staying longer.

sources.label: MFA Armenia: Visa requirements for foreigners

routes.processing: Up to 3 working days per the eVisa portal.

routes.name: Invitation-based visitor visa
routes.summary: Some nationalities can only get a visitor visa with an invitation, applied for at an Armenian diplomatic mission or consulate. An Armenian company, government body, or accredited embassy submits the invitation.

other: Only for nationalities on the MFA invitation list.
Individuals submit invitations to the Migration and Citizenship Service.

steps: Inviter submits the invitation via e-request.am (legal entities) or to the Migration and Citizenship Service (individuals).
Pay the consular fee at a commercial bank or online.
Apply for the visa at an Armenian mission.

sources.label: MFA Armenia: Visa requirements for foreigners

routes.name: Temporary resident card
routes.summary: One-year card for people who study, hold a work permit, run a business, or are close family of an Armenian citizen or a temporary resident. Can be extended by another year.

other: Basis can be: study in Armenia, a work permit, business activity, spouse/parent/child of a temporary resident, or spouse/parent/child/sibling/grandparent/grandchild of an Armenian citizen or special passport holder.
Work permit rules are not covered here. See the Migration and Citizenship Service.

stay.note: One-year extension possible. Apply at least 30 days before expiry.

steps: Apply to the Migration and Citizenship Service, 14 Tairov Street, Yerevan.
Pay the fee by E-payments, bank or terminal.
documents: Passport, copy, and notarized Armenian translation
Documents proving your basis for residence

sources.label: MFA Armenia: Temporary and Permanent Residency

routes.name: Permanent resident card
routes.summary: Five-year card, renewable for five more. For spouses or close relatives of an Armenian citizen after 3 years of legal stay, and for people running a business in Armenia.

other: Spouse or relative (sibling, grandparent, grandchild) of an Armenian citizen or special passport holder, with adequate housing or property in Armenia and 3 years of legal residence before applying.
Or running business activity in Armenia.

stay.note: Extend for 5 more years. Apply at least 30 days before expiry.

documents: Passport, copy, and notarized Armenian translation

sources.label: MFA Armenia: Temporary and Permanent Residency

routes.name: Special residency status (special passport)
routes.summary: Ten-year status for foreigners of Armenian descent and for people who have given major service to Armenia or work in its economy or culture. You get a special passport and need no entry visa.

other: Armenian descent (proved by baptism record, official document, or a parent, grandparent or sibling's papers), or distinguished service or economic/cultural activity in Armenia.
Granted by the Prime Minister. Rights match citizens except voting, running for office and joining political parties. Exempt from military service.

steps: Apply at an Armenian embassy or consulate, or in Armenia at the Migration and Citizenship Service.
documents: Letter to the Ambassador or Consul General with your details and reason
routes.processing: Usually 3 to 4 months, longer in some cases.

sources.label: MFA Armenia: Temporary and Permanent Residency

routes.name: Armenian citizenship
routes.summary: Citizenship is granted by presidential decree. Since January 2026 applications go only through the mcs-citizenship.am system. The state fee is 50,000 AMD.

other: Residence years, language and exam requirements are set in the Law on Citizenship and were not on the page read, so check them before applying.
Foreign documents need an apostille or consular legalization, and an Armenian translation.

citizenship.note: MFA says getting another citizenship does not automatically cost you Armenian citizenship. Requirements for naturalization were not confirmed.
